Faq.title: Questions before we start.
Faq.lead: What usually holds a decision back.

time.q: How long does a website take?
time.a: Between two and twelve weeks depending on scope. The simplest landing takes two; a bilingual e-commerce site can take three months. The timeline is agreed in writing before we start.

start.q: What do I need to begin?
start.a: An idea of what you want to achieve and a reference you like. If you don't have a logo, copy or photos, we can solve that too: it is part of the work, not a prerequisite.

existing.q: I already have a site. Can it be rebuilt?
existing.a: Yes, and it is usually faster than starting from zero. We review what works, what is worth keeping and what gets replaced. Existing content is migrated, not lost.

content.a: We do, from an interview and whatever you already have. If you prefer to write it yourself, we edit it so it works on screen. We never publish placeholder text.

remote.q: Do you work with projects in other cities?
remote.a: Yes. The whole process runs over video calls and shared links. We work with projects across Argentina and with clients in other markets.

after.a: It includes a training session and thirty days of adjustments. After that you can maintain it yourself or keep us on a monthly support and improvement plan.

Cookies.title: Your privacy matters too
Cookies.description: We use technical storage to keep Paleoware working properly and, if you agree, analytics to understand how the site is used and improve the experience.
Cookies.necessaryDescription: Remember basic preferences, protect the form and store your consent decision.
Cookies.analyticsDescription: Helps measure visits, events, contact buttons and forms through Google Analytics.
Cookies.intro: This policy explains how Paleoware uses cookies and similar technologies on paleoware.com.
Cookies.responsible: Responsible party: Marcos Andres Ortega · CUIT: 20-40430741-0. Contact: info@paleoware.com · +54 11 3411-7299.

sections.title: What are cookies?
sections.body: Cookies are small files that a website may store in a browser. Similar technologies, such as localStorage and sessionStorage, may also be used to remember preferences and maintain basic functions.

sections.title: Necessary technologies
sections.body: Paleoware uses technical storage to remember light and dark mode, maintain certain navigation preferences, store the cookie decision and protect the contact form from spam through Cloudflare Turnstile. These technologies are not used to build advertising profiles.

sections.title: Google Analytics
sections.body: If you accept it, Google Analytics helps us understand how many people visit the site, which pages they view, which language they use and how they interact with buttons and forms. It does this through small files called cookies. Analytics remains disabled until you give your consent.

sections.title: Cloudflare Turnstile
sections.body: The contact form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to verify that submissions come from people and reduce spam. It may make technical requests to Cloudflare and use storage mechanisms provided by the service. It is necessary to submit the form.

sections.title: Fonts and external services
sections.body: The site's fonts are hosted locally. Links to WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook lead to third-party sites, which apply their own policies once you leave Paleoware.

sections.title: Consent management
sections.body: You can accept, reject or configure optional technologies. Your decision is kept for six months and can be changed from the Cookie preferences link in the footer.

sections.title: Deleting storage
sections.body: You can delete cookies and browser storage through your browser settings. Some visual or navigation preferences may be lost when you do so.

sections.title: Changes and contact
sections.body: This policy may be updated when the technologies or providers we use change. For cookie and privacy questions, write to info@paleoware.com.

Privacy.intro: This policy explains what information we may receive, why we use it and how you can exercise your rights.
Privacy.responsible: Responsible party: Marcos Andres Ortega · CUIT: 20-40430741-0. Contact: info@paleoware.com · +54 11 3411-7299.

sections.title: Information we may receive
sections.body: We may receive your name, email address, phone number, written messages, audio recordings, images, documents or other files you voluntarily send. We may also receive information about your project, business or requested service, details needed to arrange a meeting and technical information related to the operation of the form and security services. This information may arrive through the website form, email, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook or any other channel you choose to use.

sections.title: How we use the information
sections.body: We use the information to answer enquiries, understand project needs, prepare quotes or proposals, arrange meetings and communications, send information related to an enquiry you started, provide contracted services and comply with legal obligations. Technical information may also be used to operate the site and form. Paleoware does not sell or rent personal data.

sections.title: Temporary retention of information
sections.body: Phone numbers, audio recordings, images, documents and messages may be kept for as long as necessary to answer an enquiry, understand the project, prepare a proposal or arrange a service. When they are no longer needed, we seek to delete or anonymise them. We do not keep this information indefinitely. If an enquiry leads to a commercial relationship, some data may be kept for as long as necessary to manage the service, document the relationship or comply with legal obligations.

sections.title: Providers that may be involved
sections.body: To operate Paleoware, we may use Cloudflare for hosting, infrastructure and technical services; Cloudflare Turnstile to verify form submissions; Resend to send messages received through the form; Google Analytics to measure site usage when you give consent; and WhatsApp, Instagram or Facebook when you choose to contact us through those services. Some providers may process information on servers outside Argentina and apply their own privacy policies. Paleoware does not use received data to build advertising profiles or sell information to third parties.

sections.title: Google Analytics
sections.body: Google Analytics is disabled by default and only activated when you accept analytics technologies through the cookie banner. It may then collect information about visits, pages viewed, language, general traffic source and interactions with the site. You can change your decision through the Cookie preferences link.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to the personal data we retain, correction or updating of inaccurate information, deletion of data that is no longer needed, information about how your data is used and an end to commercial communications. You may also withdraw consent where applicable. To make a request, write to info@paleoware.com with your name, the channel used to contact us and a clear description of your request. We will respond within the time limits applicable under current law.

sections.title: Communications
sections.body: We only send communications related to an enquiry, proposal or service you requested. If we send commercial communications in the future, you may ask us to stop at any time by writing to info@paleoware.com.

sections.title: Children
sections.body: Paleoware does not intentionally seek to collect personal data from children. If a parent or responsible adult believes that a child has sent us information, they may request its deletion by writing to our contact email.

sections.title: External links
sections.body: The site may contain links to WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook or other third-party sites. When you access those services, your information is subject to each provider's privacy policies and terms. Paleoware does not control how those services process information outside our site.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy when our practices, the services we use or applicable law change. The current version will always be available on this page and will show its update date.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy or how your personal data is handled, write to info@paleoware.com. Marcos Andres Ortega · CUIT: 20-40430741-0 · +54 11 3411-7299.

Privacy.argentinaNote: Data subjects may exercise their right of access to their data free of charge at intervals of no less than six months, unless a legitimate interest is established under applicable law. The Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública is the supervisory authority for Law No. 25,326 on the Protection of Personal Data in Argentina.

AboutPage.title: Paleoware: strategy, design and custom web development
AboutPage.description: Learn what Paleoware does, how we work, which projects we accept and how we support each web project.
AboutPage.intro: Paleoware creates distinctive websites for businesses, brands and projects that need to be clear, reliable and built on a solid foundation.
AboutPage.whatBody: We combine strategy, content, design, development and measurement to turn an idea or business into a clear digital presence. We operate mainly in Argentina, but accept projects from anywhere in the world.
AboutPage.scaleBody: We work with small and medium-sized projects: institutional sites, landing pages, catalogues, simple stores and web experiences that do not need a huge technical system. If you need a highly complex platform, many simultaneous users or a large backend, we are probably not the right team.
AboutPage.methodLead: Every project starts with questions and ends with a website built to do a specific job. Our method keeps decisions in order, so design does not run ahead of the problem and development does not become a chain of improvisations.

dig.name: Discovery
dig.desc: We start by understanding what you need to achieve, who needs to find you and what a visitor should do when they arrive. We review context, references and project constraints to separate what matters now from what can wait. Before drawing a screen, we define the problem the website needs to solve.

classify.name: Structure
classify.desc: We turn that conversation into a map of content and journeys. We organise information, establish hierarchy and decide what each section needs in order to be clear. We also identify missing copy, images or materials, so content is part of the project from the beginning rather than a last-minute obstacle.

assemble.name: Design and development
assemble.desc: With the structure approved, we build a visual identity and interface that can carry the project's message. We design the important states, adapt the experience to different screen sizes and develop a fast, maintainable and accessible foundation. The work advances through concrete decisions, limited review rounds and a visible scope.

hatch.name: Launch
hatch.desc: Before launch we review content, links, forms and the experience on real devices. We connect the domain and relevant measurement tools, put the site online and explain how to maintain it. After publishing, we support the included adjustments so the website does not become abandoned the moment it goes live.

conditions: The scope is approved before work begins. Changes outside that scope are reviewed and quoted separately.
Cancellations must be communicated within the first 10 business days.
The deposit is non-refundable: it reserves the schedule and covers initial project costs.
If requested materials are not delivered within the first 5 business days, the project may be paused.
If missing materials exceed 15 business days, the project is considered closed.
AboutPage.contactBody: Want to know if your project is a fit? Write to us and we will talk it through.
